newsitem.title: UK: GUS up on bullish press comment.
newsitem.headline: GUS up on bullish press comment.

text.p: Shares in Great Universal Stores Plc rose on Tuesday on an upbeat press report, dealers said.
The shares were up 13p to 646-1/2p by 0922 GMT, adding to Monday's 7p rise on the back of its acquisition of Direct Marketing Technology and an upgrade from SBC Warburg.
The Times said the retailing group's most recent acquisition was a good match for Experian, which GUS acquired last year.
"The two acquisitions leave GUS looking quite different to a year ago..." the newspaper said.

Once the company refocuses its businesses and removes its dependency on the declining agency business, "GUS will look not just healthy, but downright attractive," the Times added. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
